note: Product and service names that no longer exist (or that a site borrowed from somewhere they no longer apply), which copy should not name as current (four-site audit 2026-11-17: the swimwear site's privacy page offered Skype). The stage 10 SEO audit warns stand_in_lexicon for each one a page's text uses, for Site Factory to reword; it never rewrites copy. Each term is matched as a whole word in the case it is written (a proper name; a term that is also a common word, such as Vine, is left out).

terms.why: Microsoft retired Skype in May 2025 (Teams replaced it)
Google+ closed to consumers in April 2019
Google Hangouts was retired in 2022 (Google Chat and Meet replaced it)
Google Universal Analytics stopped processing data in July 2023 (GA4 replaced it)
Microsoft retired Internet Explorer 11 in June 2022
Adobe ended Flash Player in December 2020
Microsoft closed Windows Live Messenger in 2013-2014
